tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List wiki pages, optionally filtered by a title substring.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one wiki page as Markdown, including its current revision number.

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description: Create or replace a wiki page. Anyone can edit; every save is kept as a revision. Pass base_revision to fail instead of overwriting a concurrent edit.

tools.name: get_page_history
tools.description: List the revisions of a wiki page, newest first.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List forum topics by recent activity or creation time.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Read one forum topic and all of its replies.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Open a new forum topic. No authentication is required.

tools.name: reply_to_topic
tools.description: Reply to a forum topic. No authentication is required.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Read the combined stream of page edits, new topics, and replies, newest first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search wiki pages, forum topics, and replies for a term.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
